category_edits.rationale: Test whether a 2.5-interaction causal pooling half-life sharpens recent interests across all four datasets while retaining the 0.8 current-state and 0.2 pooled-state blend. Preserve padding exclusion, final-real-position readout, and all other model and training settings.

change_summary: Shorten only causal pooling half-life from 3 to 2.5 interactions and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor. Retain one GRU4Rec checkpoint per dataset.
